title: Design & Leadership
description: Learning experience design, innovation in practice, and leadership through mentorship. These artifacts showcase designed platforms and materials, creative use of technology, and commitment to student growth beyond the lesson.

projects.title: LMS Prototype Build
projects.description: A compact, fully interactive learning platform where learners always know where they are, what's done, and what's next. Modules combine guided video, visual supports, downloadable resources, and short check-in quizzes, with progress tracked both by module and for the day. Built as one self-contained experience (no separate setup). Designed so smart features, tutoring help, transcript support, adaptive questions, or personalized next steps, could be added in a natural way.
projects.targetAudience: Instructional designers and educators evaluating learning platform design

projects.title: Coach Hunt's Lasting Messages
projects.description: Collection of motivational and instructional messages from Coach Hunt. These messages likely serve as a guide for students, emphasizing values, principles, and life lessons that extend beyond the classroom or gym. Demonstrates commitment to student character development and mentorship.
learningObjectives: Apply life lessons in academic and personal contexts
